derivation:
by
  apply _root_.WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq_ne_zero (𝓦p p)
  simpa only [show (4 : Rp p) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, sq_eq_zero_iff, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (Rp p) p, Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq (Fact.out : p.Prime) Nat.prime_two] using hp2
explanation: Mathlib proves Ψ₂Sq is nonzero for any Weierstrass curve when 4 is nonzero in its coefficient ring. Specialize to 𝓦p p; the scalar condition follows from primality and p ≠ 2. The Mathlib proof is independent of this theorem.
